lines.text: A variable holds one thing. But what if your game needs to remember ten names, or fifty high scores? You need a list!
A list is like a variable with numbered boxes.
Item 1, item 2, item 3… One list can hold many words or numbers.
Use “item (2) of fruits” to read the second thing.
The length of the list tells you how many items it holds.
Lists remember items even after the program stops.
Use “delete all of” when the flag is clicked so the list doesn’t keep growing.
Pick a random position from 1 to the length of the list.
This is how games choose a random word, question or prize.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
